theme.name: Collaborative development and consultation
theme.claim: The plan was developed with ORR, train companies, consumer groups, technology firms and retailers, and delivery will involve passenger groups and third parties.

text.line: The industry will engage with other third parties to publicise this opportunity.
RDG will produce a transparent roadmap of current capability to identify what can be done in the short term.

DfT and RDG will collaborate on a strategy to ensure a consistent high quality customer experience of TVMs, including the role of the TVM Design Guidelines and consider whether these contain principles which should form the basis for obligations in future franchise agreements.
We will engage with passenger groups / focus groups to ensure these are understandable and accessible.

theme.name: Longer-term reform via franchising
theme.claim: Deeper fares reforms will take time and will be delivered through the franchising programme and further work with industry.

text.line: These changes will take time to deliver, and we will seek to deliver any reforms through the franchising programme.

Any changes to the fares structure must strike a balance between protecting passengers from possible market abuse, allowing train operators scope for innovation, and managing possible cost pressures on the taxpayer.

theme.name: Ticket availability and advance sales management

text.line: This will be available from six train companies and the rail industry will ensure that sale and use of Advance tickets is managed so that customers making last minute reservations do not impact on customers already using the booked service.

theme.name: Refunds and proof of railcard entitlement

text.line: In a similar manner as for when a Season Ticket left at home, customers will be able to provide proof of their Railcard online, by post or at the ticket ofifce of the train company that they travelled with in order to obtain a refund or cancellation of additional charge, including the cost of any extra fare and any penalty fare issued.
